summary: Read a list of integers that may not be sorted. Choose some of them so that they keep their original left to right order and each later choice is strictly larger than the choice before it. Skipping values is allowed. Such a choice is a strictly increasing subsequence. Find the length of a longest one and write that length. When several choices share that length, write only the length and do not list the choices.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
